data.title: Super Micro Finally Names a CFO, Nearly Two Years After an Accounting Review Prompted the Search
data.description: Super Micro stock drops 9.6% as former Western Digital exec Mark Long takes over as CFO while the company addresses internal accounting and export-control scrutiny.

data.title: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Doubles Down on CapEx as Agentic AI Expands, Say Bullish Analysts
data.description: TSMC shares fell despite record profits. Analysts maintained Buy ratings, with Needham raising its target to $560 on strong AI-driven growth.

data.title: GameStop’s Collectibles Push, Trading Card Buybacks, eBay Stake Offer Strategic Upside, Analyst Says

data.title: Tesla's Flying Roadster Sends Delivery Odds Tumbling Despite Spectacular Demo
data.description: Roadster delivery odds fell from 33% to 14% after Elon Musk said production would not begin until 2028.
